title: ADR-002: AVARICE supplies services to GSD and never orchestrates the loop
summary: Decides AVARICE owns the run envelope (intake, context, ledger, evidence, authorization) while GSD owns plan-to-ship; AVARICE integrates as services, not orchestrator.
notes: Status is Proposed (not Accepted), so locked is false. Partially superseded by ADR-006 for unattended runs. Manifest-declared type ADR and precedence 2 applied as authoritative. Content signals (Status, Context/Decision/Consequences, Alternatives, Revisit when) confirm ADR. The SHA-256 source_hash could not be computed (no shell tool available), so the filename omits the 8-char hash suffix; orchestrator should rename per the naming convention if collision avoidance is needed.
